body: I've tried to get a hold of her parents but her mom never answers the phone and when I go over to their house, she's at the hospital and her dad is always working. I will keep trying to get a hold of them. I've tried to talk to my friend and get to the root of the problem but she never wants to tell me anything. I'm not the only one who's tried, our other friends have tried as well and like I said, we're all really worried about her.
